method: Whole production population before/after: fresh no-cache snapshots of the Stage C/C-S unit loaders (scripts/build_8c_stageC.py: Stage B corpora, Germanic, Balto-Slavic, sa-ep/grc-late), content words (form, lemma, ids) aligned per unit; 'before' was taken before this worker's edits (it already contained other workers' work in progress at that time), 'after' with all cq1 work present; every changed token is attributed to a rule, and changes due to the lead's z-cq1-formulas.json / cq1_formulas.py are listed separately. No search-index or Stage C-S artifacts were written. Scripts: scratchpad cq1/other/snap.py, diff.py.

not_changed_classes.greek_capitalised_lemmas: grc units: 8493 mapped tokens (468 lemma types) have a capitalised GLAUx lemma: Ζεύς (theonym) and letter labels Α/Ε/Η, but also ethnonyms and personal names mapped through common-word homographs (Ἀχαιός, Θεσσαλός, Ἀρκάς, Θρᾷξ, Φρύξ, Μακεδών, Κύκλωψ, Τελαμών ...). Only Μῆδος (reported) and Homeric Πολίτης were changed; a general rule is a policy decision for the lead/owner.
not_changed_classes.byliny_capitalised_verbs_as_names: byliny: 2456 name-tagged tokens whose lemma is a verb; mixed real names (Владим->ладить, Щелкан) and capitalised sentence-initial verbs (Фхать, Говоритъ). bsl_mapping.is_name gets no punctuation context from the Stage C loader; not changed.
not_changed_classes.byliny_prose_leaks: Rybnikov vol. 2 (narod72) L22645-38731 is Bessonov's Roman-paginated essay with ~2900 emitted units, and Rybnikov vol. 4 has further ethnographic prose (e.g. L12002-12500); Kireevsky vyp. 1 L23466-23491, 23596-23699 also prose. Only the reported paragraphs were excluded.

note_on_alignment: token_changes_by_rule counts aligned word changes per unit; where several words of one window change, alignment can merge them, so the per-rule figures are lower bounds. Exact rule hits for the unlemmatised-name rule are in norse_unlemmatised_name_rule_tokens (all source occurrences meeting the rule).
